provenance.instrument: Code of the Township of Cheltenham, Chapter 295 Zoning (Cheltenham Township Zoning Ordinance of 2017, Ord. No. 2358-17), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 (code CH1316) dated 2025-09-17. Chapter 295 history includes Ord. No. 2492-25 (7-16-2025). New Laws lists two uncodified Chapter 295 amendments: Ord. 2502-25 (MU3 Class 3 special exception standards) and Ord. 2503-25 (medical marijuana dispensaries in MU1). Both were opened. Neither touches residential districts or accessory dwellings.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 code date 2025-09-17. New Laws: 11 items, two of them Chapter 295 amendments adopted 2025-11-19 (Ord. 2502-25, 2503-25).
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, accessory apartment or in-law provision
A single-family detached dwelling must be 'the only dwelling unit located on the parcel' and may have only one kitchen (295-405B(6) Use G-6(e))
R1 to R4 allow the listed uses 'and no other'. Uses not listed are not permitted (295-403D). A lot may not be partitioned to add a principal use (295-402E)

R3 and R4 allow a duplex (one unit above the other) by right on a lot of at least 7,500 sq ft (Use G-3). A duplex conversion of a house on a smaller nonconforming lot of 5,000 sq ft or more is a special exception

R4: the Zoning Hearing Board may allow conversion of a dwelling that existed when the chapter took effect (2017) to up to three families, 2,000 sq ft of lot per family, only for a building of little use as a single-family house (295-805)

Accessory structures (Use A-1): no taller than the house or 25 ft. Over 250 sq ft or over 16 ft high, they must meet the principal yards and stay within 50% of the house's building area. 10 ft from other structures
A pool house may have at most two of bedroom, bathroom and kitchen (Use A-9)
Short-term transient lodging (Use B-40) is listed only in commercial and mixed-use districts. The definition of dwelling excludes short-term rentals
No rental agreement may be signed until the township issues a rental license for the property. Rental property is inspected at least once every three years (227-2A, 227-7A)

status.note: The code has no ADU text. A single-family detached dwelling 'is the only dwelling unit located on the parcel'.

path.note: 'Any use not permitted ... is not permitted in the district in question.' A second unit on a house lot needs a use variance (295-403E).

value.name: Duplex (two-family, one unit above the other)
value.conditions: One unit above the other (duplex), each with its own outside entrance. Lot at least 7,500 sq ft. Public water and sewer. Three bedrooms at most per unit. 2 parking spaces per unit. District yards apply.

value.name: Duplex conversion of a single-family house on a nonconforming lot
value.conditions: Lot of at least 5,000 sq ft that is below the 7,500 sq ft duplex minimum. Other duplex rules apply.

value.name: Conversion of an existing dwelling for up to three families
value.conditions: Only a dwelling that stood in R4 at the effective date of the chapter (11-15-2017). At least 2,000 sq ft of lot per family. District yards and building area not reduced. No major exterior change. Only for a building of little economic value or use as a single-family house.

alternatives.note: Not ADUs. Two units in R4 conversion need 4,000 sq ft (2,000 per family). G-3: 'minimum lot size for duplex dwellings shall be 7,500 square feet.'

zoning_districts.note: No district lists an ADU. Reading of a silent code.

historic_bypass.note: No ADU text, so no historic path.

types_allowed.note: No ADU form is listed. A house may have only one kitchen.

max_height_ft.note: Accessory structure rule, not an ADU rule. 'shall not exceed the height of the principal building on the lot or 25 feet, whichever is less.'

height_capped_at_house.note: 'shall not exceed the height of the principal building'

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: Applies to accessory structures over 250 sq ft or over 16 ft high: 'shall comply with the principal yard setbacks'. Smaller ones need 4 ft from side and rear lines.

setback_side_ft.note: 4 ft only for structures under 250 sq ft and under 16 ft. Larger structures take the district side yard.

setback_rear_ft.note: 4 ft only for structures under 250 sq ft and under 16 ft. Larger structures take the district rear yard.

setback_front_ft.note: 'A detached accessory structure shall not be erected within the front yard area'.

separation_ft.note: 'shall not be constructed closer than 10 feet from any other structures'

front_yard_barred.note: 'A detached accessory structure shall not be erected within the front yard area'.

family_only.note: No ADU rule. A family allows at most one person unrelated to the others.

max_adus.note: Reading: 0 means the code allows no ADU. The house must be the only dwelling unit on the parcel.

short_term_rental_banned.note: Reading: Use B-40 short-term lodging is not listed in R1 to R4, and 'Any use not permitted ... is not permitted'. A dwelling 'shall not be construed to include short-term transient lodging'.

spaces_required.note: No ADU row. Single-family detached: 2 per unit. Duplex: 2 per unit.

setback_front_ft.note: 50 ft or the average of the 2 closest adjacent structures.

setback_rear_ft.note: Principal yard. Accessory structures over 250 sq ft or 16 ft also meet it (295-405A(1)(d)).
